name: Chance Meeting with a Lover
source:
You find yourself in a room, talking with a man about his life. He won't let you speak beyond a few prompts, but he seems to have a lot on his mind. It seems he's lonely and has been wanting someone to talk to.

[From [url=https://marinehaddock.itch.io/chance-meeting-with-a-lover]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己身处一个房间，正在与一名男子谈论他的人生。除了偶尔回应几句，他几乎不给你开口的机会，可他似乎确实心事重重。看起来，他很孤独，一直想找个人说说话。

（摘自[url=https://marinehaddock.itch.io/chance-meeting-with-a-lover]itch.io[/url]）
